description: This file defines the implementation of the LiveRegionHost class, which manages accessibility live region announcements in a Windows UI application. It includes methods to check host availability, create a host, and announce updates for screen readers.

classes.name: LiveRegionHost
classes.description: A class that manages accessibility live region announcements for screen readers, providing methods to check availability, create a host, and announce updates.

methods.name: IsHostAvailable
methods.description: Returns true indicating the live region host is always available.

methods.name: MakeHost
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of LiveRegionHost.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a message to screen readers by updating the live region's properties and raising an automation event.
